title: mentha × verticillata var. fallax
intro: Mentha × verticillata var. fallax, commonly known as American Mountain Mint, is a variety of the peppermint plant native to the mountainous regions of North America. This plant is known for its health benefits, particularly in alleviating digestive issues and reducing nausea, due to its ability to ease stomach cramps and relax the muscles. The therapeutic actions of American Mountain Mint include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which help to relieve pain, reduce inflammation, and calm muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, menthyl acetate, and menthol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and fragrant aroma.
